articles.title: Articles
articles.description: Write, edit, and publish blog articles.
articles.emptyDescription: Write your first article. It stays a draft until you publish it.
articles.deleteDraft: This draft will be deleted permanently.
articles.deletePublished: This article is live. It will be removed from the site and deleted permanently.

toast.revalidationPending: Saved, but the live site has not refreshed yet. It will retry automatically.
toast.copied: Your content was copied to the clipboard
toast.copyFailed: Could not copy to the clipboard. Nothing was reloaded.

errors.titleTooLong: The title can be at most 200 characters
errors.slugTooLong: The slug can be at most 120 characters
errors.slugFormat: Use lowercase letters, numbers, and single dashes
errors.excerptTooLong: The excerpt can be at most 300 characters
errors.metaTitleTooLong: The meta title can be at most 120 characters
errors.metaDescriptionTooLong: The meta description can be at most 320 characters

settings.title: Article settings
settings.description: URL, summary, cover, category, tags, and search appearance. Saved with the article.
settings.slugHint: The last part of the URL. Leave empty to generate it from the title.
settings.excerptHint: One or two sentences shown under the title and in article lists. Required to publish.
settings.noTags: No tags yet. Create them under Tags.
settings.noDescription: Add an excerpt or a meta description.
settings.titleTooLong: Titles over {{max}} characters get cut off.
settings.descriptionTooLong: Descriptions over {{max}} characters get cut off.

checklist.title: Ready to publish?
checklist.description: Publishing puts the article on the live site.
checklist.savesFirst: Your unsaved changes are saved first.

items.title: Title
items.imageAlt_zero: Every body image has alt text
items.imageAlt_one: {{count}} body image has no alt text
items.imageAlt_other: {{count}} body images have no alt text

conflict.title: This article was changed elsewhere
conflict.description: Someone saved a newer version (maybe in another tab). Reload to get it — your changes here will be lost — or copy your content first.

editor.restoreDescription: This browser has a newer copy of this article from {{time}} that was never saved.
editor.bodyInvalid: The article body has a problem
editor.leaveDescription: Your changes to this article have not been saved. A local copy is kept in this browser.
editor.unpublishDescription: It will be removed from the live site and go back to Draft. You can publish it again later.

previewScreen.fromEditor: Showing the current editor content, including unsaved changes.
previewScreen.emptyDescription: Open the preview from the editor to see the article as visitors will.

paste.imagesDropped: Images from pasted content were not added. Upload them to the media library first.
paste.oneImage: Only the first image was used. Add the others one at a time.

link.title: Link
link.description: Link the selected text, or insert the link if nothing is selected.
link.hint: https://, http://, mailto:, or a site path such as /blog/my-post or #section.
link.invalid: Use an https://, http://, or mailto: link, or a path starting with / or #.

image.missing: Image not found in the media library
image.caption: Caption

embed.title: Embed
embed.description: Paste a link from {{providers}}. It loads only when a visitor clicks it.
embed.unsupported: This link is not from a supported provider.
embed.caption: Caption

bookmark.title: Link card
bookmark.description: A card with the page title, description, and site. No remote image is shown.
bookmark.hint: The details are fetched from the page; you can edit them.
bookmark.httpsOnly: Link cards need an https:// URL.
bookmark.fetchFailed: Could not fetch the page details. You can fill them in yourself.

table.insertDescription: Pick a size. You can add or remove rows and columns later.

dragHandle.label: Drag to move, click for block options
